method.contrast: WCAG 2.2 relative luminance, truncated to two decimals (scripts/contrast.ts). APCA Lc 0.0.98G-4g, text rows only, advisory.
method.rampRule: each step is a CIE L* tone (HCT tone); hue held; chroma = min(0.95 x sRGB max, mark chroma x taper), the taper paling tints toward white (to 15% at tone 100) and easing shades toward black (to 55% at tone 0); yellow may drift warmer below its own tone
method.bloom: oklch(0.86 0.09 h) at alpha 0.22 over stage
method.rim: oklch(0.93 0.04 h) at alpha 0.28 over stageRaised
method.cvd: Machado 2009, severity 1.0, in linear sRGB; distances in OKLab x100

the four together: an expressive section may show all four as light (bloom), never as flat fills side by side

candidates.name: Spectral

drops: no gradients between brand hues: one band through the four in reading order, interpolated in OKLCH, is allowed on the stage; a direct blue-to-yellow blend stays banned (it greys)
no colour dots on dark grounds: the one mark serves every ground
the four together only in the mark: an expressive section may use the four as one spectrum
